current.text: Peyton Watson is gone and DeMar DeRozan has joined Denver.
The open questions are whether the new pieces fit together and how David Adelman sets the rotation.
Projected starters are Jamal Murray, Christian Braun, Cam Johnson, Aaron Gordon and Nikola Jokic.
Projected bench is DeRozan, Spencer Jones, Marvin Bagley, Tyus Jones and Julian Strawther. The depth chart also lists Zeke Nnaji and Cam Whitmore in the second unit.
Depth behind Aaron Gordon at power forward is very poor.
The team is mostly healthy heading into the season.
Denver has 14 back-to-backs, rank 12 of 30. The expert calls this one of the lowest counts in the league and rates the schedule as good.
The fantasy playoff schedule is strong: 11 games in weeks 19 to 21 (rank 4 of 30). Week 19 has 4 games with no back-to-back, so stars are less likely to rest that week.
The Nuggets have one of only three five-game weeks this season.
Do not draft Zeke Nnaji in round two just because he plays with Jokic. Jamal Murray is a fine pick there.
Denver is trying to win now.
The win total is 49.5 (rank 6 of 30). Moore predicts 50 wins but a weaker team than last season.
Moore doubts the team will rest Gordon, Murray and Jokic on purpose.
Moore doubts ownership will pay the luxury tax. He expects at least two of last year's starters, including Cam Johnson, to be traded by the deadline.
Cam Johnson and Christian Braun are named as possible trade pieces.
Losing Tim Hardaway Jr. leaves Denver short on spacing. The team needs shooters willing to shoot off Jokic's gravity.

durable.text: Backup centers in Denver historically do not produce, even ones who looked fine elsewhere.
Experts have concerns about the Nuggets training staff, given the team's injury history.

note: Denver is a win-now team with a strong playoff schedule (11 games in weeks 19 to 21), and experts do not expect it to rest its stars on purpose. That helps Jokic and Murray, but backup centers like Zeke Nnaji rarely produce here and should not be drafted early. Early on, watch how Adelman uses DeRozan, who covers the thin power forward spot behind Gordon, and watch for Cam Johnson or Christian Braun trade news before the 2027-03-04 deadline.
